text:
Nora L.: starting thread 1: Cinder Labs wants a compact POC plan: HIPAA considerations, eval harness, and an estimate for a short Dedicated trial. Need to nail success criteria before Wed sync.
Diego M.: are they okay with hosted + VPC endpoints or do they require a private on-prem? that affects KMS/HSM and data residency.
Priya (pre-sales): client prefers hosted with strict VPC peering + BYOK, must show encryption-in-transit + at-rest and SOC2 + HIPAA BAAs. retention windows are sensitive (logs <= 180 days).
Omar: noted. drafting success metrics: intent accuracy, entity extraction F1, hallucination rate, and token-level cost. suggest numeric targets.
Nora L.: draft thresholds: intent accuracy >= 90% on golden intents, entity F1 >= 85%, hallucination <= 1.5% on golden set, mean latency < 220ms, p99 < 450ms. privacy gate: zero leaked PHI examples.
Diego M.: add a throughput constraint: POC peak 300 qps, average 60 qps; but limit to 5k requests/day during trial. pricing should show hosted vs short-term dedicated reserved window.
Priya (pre-sales): for the harness we should curate 300 golden cases: 200 standard, 60 adversarial (fuzzy/ambiguous), 40 privacy stress tests (PHI redaction). cover 5 clinician personas + 10 system prompt-injection cases.
Omar: propose scoring formula (initial):
```
- intent_score: 0-100 (weight 40%)
- entity_f1: 0-100 (weight 25%)
- hallucination_binary: 0/100 (fail=0, pass=100) (weight 20%)
- safety_review: manual-pass/fail (weight 10%)
- latency_penalty: 0-100 normalized (weight 5%)
Final >= 82 for pass. Any safety/manual fail -> immediate fail regardless of score.
```
Priya (pre-sales): legal insists on a privacy gate: if any PHI is reproduced verbatim in outputs during a run -> fail and freeze rollout. also request sample answers to security questionnaire; I'll prepare but need ops confirmation for BYOK flow.
Nora L.: regression gates: if weekly rolling mean final score drops >2% from baseline OR any privacy stress test triggers twice in a row -> automatic rollback. also require a daily smoke run pre-demo.
Diego M.: harness cadence: nightly runs + a mid-day sanity check during demo windows. store run artifacts (per-example JSONL) to s3://redwood-poc/cinderlab/<run_ts> with digest and tags.
Omar: instrumentation: log token counts, model_version, prompt_hash, latency_ms, score_details. we will keep anonymized transcripts for debug but redact PHI before storage.
Priya (pre-sales): deliverables to client: eval harness repo + runbook, golden dataset export (redacted), pass/fail dashboard link, and a costs appendix for a 3-week pilot vs monthly committed Dedicated.
Nora L.: capacity calc notes: assume avg prompt 60 tok, response 160 tok -> 220 tok roundtrip. POC cap set to 5k/day to keep token costs bounded. show cost examples for 5k/day vs 50k/day.
Diego M.: i'll model token-based cost and a short Dedicated monthly commit for burst days. will include rough numbers by EOD.
Omar: timeline proposal:
- Prep (pre): NDA/DPA + infra allowlist + SOC2 artifact share
- Week 1: integration + sample ingest + initial smoke harness
- Week 2: full harness run, scoring baseline, tuning
- Week 3: final regression runs, demo + findings, handoff
Priya (pre-sales): blockers: ops confirmation on BYOK path, legal sign-off on BAA, network team for VPC peering, and dataset anonymization checklist completion.
Nora L.: action items: (1) Omar: implement scoring script + baseline harness config, (2) Diego: pricing calc + capacity options, (3) Priya: prep security questionnaire answers and BAA requests, (4) Nora: coordinate kickoff and client contacts.
presales-bot: POC ticket created https://work.internal/pocs/1978001111 1: security checklist template attached.
Diego M.: suggestion: include 25 targeted negative prompts for prompt-injection, 30 hallucination probes, and a 20-case fuzz harness. run fuzzing nightly.
Omar: will add those to the adversarial bucket and include automated detection heuristics. set alert if hallucination rate > 1% on the adversarial subset.
Priya (pre-sales): client asked for demo script showing rollback in action 1: we should rehearse automated rollback + manual override.
Nora L.: will draft demo script. any other gaps? if none i'll formalize the POC scope and send to Cinder Labs for signoff by tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
